title: Recording: 3 Legs by Paul and Linda McCartney | 1971
content:
Studio B, Sound Recorders Studio, Los Angeles
Producer: Jim Guercio
Engineer: Armin Steiner

Paul McCartney worked on the Ram song ‘3 Legs’ on 2 March 1971.

This was the second recording session at Sound Recorders Studio, situated at 6226 Yucca Street in Los Angeles. Ram had hitherto been recorded in New York City.

‘3 Legs’ had been mostly recorded on 16 October 1970, with vocals and additional guitar taped on 18 January 1971. During this session McCartney added tambourine and backing vocals.

The rest of the working week at Sound Recorders was spent reviewing the album recordings with studio producer Jim Guercio.
